title: Fixture format audit
name: Fixture audit
intro: Six findings about a fixture format, each takes Fix, Later or Skip. Fixture data for the page tests.

sections.title: How suggestions count
sections.text: A suggestion applies only when you accept it, row by row or with the box at Submit.

items.title: Header line has no version
items.reason: Old files cannot be told from new ones.
items.context: The first line is `# fixture` only.

items.title: Blank lines end a record
items.reason: Works today; breaks if a record gains a paragraph.

items.title: File names mix case
items.reason: A case-insensitive disk would merge two fixtures.

items.title: Suffix says .txt
items.reason: No view yet; depends on the editor setting.

items.title: Rename the child slug
items.reason: Shorter slug fits the tmux label.
